note: Fixed alphabets and enumerated vocabularies pinned from TEEG_02 rev 3. S0.5 pins these; it populates nothing and reads no bank.

sigma_syn.meaning: synapse-type alphabet; a per-synapse attribute of C-09, NEVER a section label

section_vocabulary.meaning: the four admissible (class, domain) pairs of C8.1, with the NEURON section-array name chosen so that LFPy.Cell.get_idx(section=...) selects on either component by substring with no extra code
section_vocabulary.constraint_C8_1: sigma_dom == 'none' if and only if sigma_cls in {'soma', 'axon'}

spine_substructure.rationale: spines are pruned and their area is carried by the field phi (C8.2)

synapse_type.rationale: a per-synapse attribute belonging to C-09. In the July 2026 bank the label slot was shared and the synapse label won: in neuron_489469961_aligned.hoc the soma itself is emitted as exc_syn[0]. Defect O8; invariants I-16 and I-18 are its regression tests

mechanism_mode.meaning: global per-simulation switch, written into provenance.json so a matched healthy-versus-perturbed pair cannot straddle modes
mechanism_mode.constraint_C15_2: mechanism_mode == 'passive' implies mech_dict is empty for all (layer, gtype)

cm_reference.meaning: which capacitance a stored cm value refers to. The passive fitting pipeline applies the spine correction inside the model, so the optimiser returns the intrinsic, shaft-referenced value. The two differ by roughly a factor 1.7 to 2.4 and are indistinguishable by inspection

spine_status.meaning: global per bank, recorded per row. 'pruned' means spine geometry removed and area retained as phi; it is NOT spine omission, in which the area is simply lost
